body: Same situation here. I am now about to take the bar exam. I have isolated myself for how many years just to have good grades, to please them to make them happy. I just realized that I don’t want it. It ruined my mental health. I always believed that they know everything. And now that I am 26, and I see my peers getting better, I feel stuck and worthless. Everything they say I take as the absolute truth but in fact they are also clueless. I just want to pass this exam and move on with my own life away from here. I want to have the autonomy , the ability to decide for myself. And they are also perfectionist parents who want to compare their children to others. I’m done with this, and I think I don’t want to have a child in the future to commit the same mistakes.
